web.title: Accenture Invests in Profitmind to Drive Agentic AI Reinvention ...
web.description: Accenture has invested, through Accenture Ventures, in Profitmind, a retail technology company that has developed an agentic AI platform to help retailers automate decisions across pricing, inventory and planning.
snippets: 8, 2026 – Accenture (NYSE: ACN) has invested, through Accenture Ventures, in Profitmind, a retail technology company that has developed an agentic AI platform to help retailers automate decisions across pricing, inventory and planning. As part of this investment, Accenture and Profitmind are also entering into a strategic partnership. This investment and partnership will further expand Accenture’s existing data and AI capabilities in retail, enabling clients to bridge the gap between insights and action. As the retail landscape undergoes significant transformation, agentic AI has emerged as a critical enabler for brands seeking to navigate unprecedented complexity.

Profitmind’s platform uses a network of intelligent AI agents that help retail teams connect pricing, inventory, promotions, and assortment data and generate relevant and timely recommendations that can be executed with the speed that is imperative in an increasingly competitive field.

Frequently considered the heart and soul of retail, executives are often overwhelmed by massive amounts of data, reports and spreadsheets, leaving little time for effective decision-making,” said Jill Standish, Accenture’s global retail lead. “Profitmind bridges the gap between insight and action through agentic AI.

The platform is designed to help merchants, planners, and marketers move faster in a market that changes in real time. Its native agentic AI architecture unifies a retailer’s strategy, internal data, and external competitive signals to deliver prioritized, explainable recommendations across pricing, promotions, inventory, marketing, and assortment.
